limitations: Symmetric origin-started continuum sluggish diffusion with alpha >=0 and independent Poisson resets r>0; no claim for microscopic discrete walks, non-Poisson resets, trajectory-level LDP, or uniform finite-T errors.
scientific_integrity: Analytic renewal-reward proof with exact Lamperti transform and explicit endpoint asymptotic; finite SciPy checks are supplementary, not an infinite proof. No claim of independent certification.
title: A sharp Lamperti-dependent endpoint law for occupation large deviations under Poisson resetting
